shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort | rg 'cache|loading|fetching|rendering|data' | head -160 && rg -n \"Cache Components|use cache|Suspense|connection\\(|dynamicIO|cacheComponents\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md 2>/dev/null || sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "cat lib/projects.ts && cat AGENTS.md && rg -n \"cacheLife\\('.*'\\)|Cache Components\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba lib/projects.ts && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,120p' && git diff --stat -- app/page.tsx lib/projects.ts next.config.ts"
